sprint: INSPECT-0 Source Register + Dutch Profile Design
authority_boundary_note: This register distinguishes inspection frameworks, curriculum or standards references, accountability systems, and non-inspection comparators. A source is not treated as curriculum authority unless its source_type and notes explicitly say so.

sources.title: Onderzoekskader 2021 voor het toezicht op het voortgezet onderwijs, versie 2025
sources.authority_boundary: Inspection framework, not economics curriculum source.
sources.why_it_matters_for_4veco: Primary Dutch VO inspection baseline for evidence categories such as basisvaardigheden, aanbod, didactic quality, support, closure, and quality assurance.
sources.notes: Use to define evidence-support categories and safe claims. Do not use inspection prose to mint MTUs or target exercises.

sources.title: Bijstelling 2025: Basisvaardigheden (OP0)
sources.authority_boundary: Inspection standard for basic skills; not a subject curriculum specification.
sources.why_it_matters_for_4veco: Defines Dutch inspection focus on Dutch language, mathematics/arithmetic, and citizenship as curriculum and classroom-practice evidence.
sources.notes: Use for OP0/basic-skills evidence mapping. Economics evidence should map calculation, graph/table/source reading, language reasoning, and citizenship/economic participation contexts where relevant.

sources.title: Bijgestelde onderzoekskaders 2025
sources.authority_boundary: Inspection-framework update page, not curriculum authority.
sources.why_it_matters_for_4veco: Records that updated Dutch research frameworks are in force from 1 August 2025 and highlights OP0 assessment changes.
sources.notes: Use for freshness checks and change-control notes in Dutch profile work.

sources.title: Referentiekader voor onderwijskwaliteit (OK)
sources.authority_boundary: Quality framework for Flemish education; local curriculum mappings require separate Flemish curriculum sources.
sources.why_it_matters_for_4veco: Closest international quality-language comparator for Dutch-language school-quality evidence.
sources.notes: Do not create a Flanders overlay in INSPECT-0; keep as source inventory only.

sources.title: What do we inspect?
sources.authority_boundary: Inspection-method source, not curriculum authority.
sources.why_it_matters_for_4veco: Identifies Flemish inspection questions around quality development, teaching and learning practice, quality areas, and regulations.
sources.notes: Useful later for overlay crosswalk categories such as quality development, teaching practice, feedback, evaluation, and learning effects.

sources.title: How do we evaluate?
sources.authority_boundary: Inspection development-scale source, not curriculum authority.
sources.why_it_matters_for_4veco: Documents development-scale language and the relationship between meets-expectation levels and OK quality expectations.
sources.notes: Later overlays should avoid turning Flemish development-scale language into Dutch compliance claims.

sources.title: Education inspection framework
sources.authority_boundary: England inspection framework; does not represent Scotland, Wales, or Northern Ireland.
sources.why_it_matters_for_4veco: Provides explicit international vocabulary for school inspection quality areas and legal inspection context.
sources.notes: Use England-specific wording. Do not call this a UK-wide framework.

sources.title: School inspection: toolkit, operating guides and information
sources.authority_boundary: Inspection operating guidance for England; not subject curriculum authority.
sources.why_it_matters_for_4veco: Shows what inspectors and schools use to discuss quality of provision under the renewed inspection framework.
sources.notes: Use as source inventory for later England overlay only.

sources.title: Qualitaetssicherung in Schulen
sources.authority_boundary: Common German quality-assurance reference; school inspection and curriculum details differ by Land.
sources.why_it_matters_for_4veco: Records the German federal-quality context around monitoring, standards, and quality development without implying one national inspection framework.
sources.notes: Any Germany overlay must be by Land or explicitly limited to common KMK quality references.

sources.title: Bildungsstandards
sources.authority_boundary: Common educational standards reference; not an economics-inspection source and not a Land curriculum.
sources.why_it_matters_for_4veco: Useful for later international common-quality mapping around standards, monitoring, and development functions.
sources.notes: No German economics local overlay is authorised in INSPECT-0.

sources.authority: Ministere de l'Education nationale / Conseil d'evaluation de l'Ecole
sources.title: Conseil d'evaluation de l'Ecole: evaluation des etablissements du second degre
sources.authority_boundary: School-evaluation framework, not economics curriculum authority.
sources.why_it_matters_for_4veco: Defines the French secondary establishment evaluation model, including self-evaluation and external evaluation references.
sources.notes: Later France work should separate lycee curriculum mapping from establishment-evaluation evidence.

sources.authority: Ministere de l'Education nationale / Conseil d'evaluation de l'Ecole
sources.title: Conseil d'evaluation de l'Ecole
sources.authority_boundary: Evaluation authority page, not curriculum source.
sources.why_it_matters_for_4veco: Explains the CEE role in defining methodological frameworks and tools for school self-evaluation and external evaluation.
sources.notes: Use for authority provenance if a France overlay is later authorised.

sources.title: Sistema nazionale di valutazione
sources.authority_boundary: National evaluation-system reference; subject/curriculum mapping requires separate local sources.
sources.why_it_matters_for_4veco: Records Italy's SNV/RAV policy context for school self-evaluation and improvement evidence.
sources.notes: Use only as source inventory in INSPECT-0.

sources.title: Valutazione delle scuole
sources.authority_boundary: School-evaluation support source; not economics curriculum authority.
sources.why_it_matters_for_4veco: Documents INVALSI's support for the SNV activities around autovalutazione and valutazione esterna.
sources.notes: Later Italy work should distinguish RAV/self-evaluation from textbook evidence.

sources.authority: Ministerio de Educacion, Formacion Profesional y Deportes
sources.title: Inspeccion del sistema educativo
sources.authority_boundary: State-level legal/inspection reference; autonomous communities regulate and exercise inspection within their territory.
sources.why_it_matters_for_4veco: Records Spain's central inspection/evaluation legal boundary and the need for autonomous-community overlays.
sources.notes: Do not create a Spain-wide compliance model; later overlays must be autonomous-community aware.

sources.title: Evaluaciones LOMLOE
sources.authority_boundary: System/diagnostic evaluation source, not school-inspection or economics curriculum source.
sources.why_it_matters_for_4veco: Documents Spain's LOMLOE system and diagnostic-evaluation model, useful for accountability compatibility notes.
sources.notes: Use to avoid confusing system evaluations with textbook approval.

sources.title: Nadzor pedagogiczny
sources.authority_boundary: Pedagogical-supervision reference; curriculum and exam mapping require separate Polish sources.
sources.why_it_matters_for_4veco: Defines the Polish supervision model around observing, analysing, evaluating processes and outcomes, conditions, support, and improvement inspiration.
sources.notes: Use as high-level source inventory only.

sources.title: Plan nadzoru pedagogicznego sprawowanego przez Ministra Edukacji na rok szkolny 2025/2026
sources.authority_boundary: Annual supervision-plan source, not subject curriculum authority.
sources.why_it_matters_for_4veco: Adds current-year freshness to the Poland source inventory.
sources.notes: Later Poland overlay work should verify the current school-year plan again.

sources.title: What is the Every Student Succeeds Act?
sources.authority_boundary: Federal accountability and transparency law; US curriculum and school quality rules are state/local and accreditation-specific.
sources.why_it_matters_for_4veco: Records why US compatibility should be framed as state/local standards, accountability, report cards, and improvement mechanisms rather than inspection compliance.
sources.notes: Do not say 4veco meets US standards.

sources.title: Key Documents: School Support and Accountability
sources.authority_boundary: Federal ESEA/ESSA state-plan source; state plans remain the operative local accountability implementations.
sources.why_it_matters_for_4veco: Provides source path for future state-by-state US accountability overlays if ever authorised.
sources.notes: Use for source inventory only; no US overlay is authorised in INSPECT-0.

sources.title: AP Microeconomics Course and Exam Description
sources.authority_boundary: Exam/course comparator, not inspection or state curriculum authority.
sources.why_it_matters_for_4veco: Useful later as a non-inspection economics comparator for concepts, graphing, calculation, and free-response expectations.
sources.notes: Comparator only. Do not treat AP as a US inspection framework.

sources.title: National Content Standards in K-12 Economics, 3rd Edition
sources.authority_boundary: National subject-content comparator, not inspection or state legal authority.
sources.why_it_matters_for_4veco: Useful later for US economics terminology and content crosswalks, if a US overlay is authorised.
sources.notes: Comparator only; local US adoption depends on state and district standards.

sources.authority: National Council for the Social Studies
sources.title: College, Career, and Civic Life (C3) Framework for Social Studies State Standards
sources.authority_boundary: Social-studies standards framework comparator, not inspection or state legal authority.
sources.why_it_matters_for_4veco: Useful later for inquiry/civic/economics compatibility notes, especially citizenship and source-based reasoning.
sources.notes: Comparator only. Do not substitute for state social-studies/economics standards.
